description: This file contains functions and types for processing, analyzing, and summarizing session usage data, including reading JSONL transcript files, extracting usage and cost information, and generating session summaries and time series.

methods.name: emptyTotals
methods.description: Creates an empty CostUsageTotals object with all counters set to zero.

methods.name: toFiniteNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if possible, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: extractCostBreakdown
methods.description: Extracts cost breakdown details from usage data.

methods.name: parseTimestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp from a transcript entry.

methods.name: parseTranscriptEntry
methods.description: Parses a raw transcript entry into a structured ParsedTranscriptEntry object.

methods.name: formatDayKey
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string for daily grouping.

methods.name: computeLatencyStats
methods.description: Computes latency statistics (average, p95, min, max) from an array of latency values.

methods.name: applyCostBreakdown
methods.description: Adds cost breakdown values to totals.

methods.name: applyCostTotal
methods.description: Adds a total cost value to totals for legacy data.

methods.name: readJsonlRecords
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and yields JSON objects from a JSONL file.

methods.name: scanTranscriptFile
methods.description: Reads a transcript file and processes each entry with a callback.

methods.name: scanUsageFile
methods.description: Reads a usage file and processes each entry with a callback.

methods.name: resolveExistingUsageSessionFile
methods.description: Resolves the file path for an existing session's usage data.

methods.name: loadCostUsageSummary
methods.description: Loads and summarizes cost and usage data over a specified time range.

methods.name: discoverAllSessions
methods.description: Discovers all session files in the directory, returning metadata for each session.

methods.name: loadSessionCostSummary
methods.description: Loads detailed cost and usage summary for a specific session.

methods.name: loadSessionUsageTimeSeries
methods.description: Loads a time series of usage data points for a session.

methods.name: loadSessionLogs
methods.description: Loads recent log entries for a session, with optional limit.
